item.title: FAI confirm Ireland Nations League will compete against Israel at Aviva despite backlash
item.description: "After taking legal advice, engaging with key stakeholders and reflecting on our constitutional obligations, we have decided that the Football Association of Ireland will fulfil both fixtures and will host the home match at the Aviva Stadium as scheduled," wrote the FAI in an open letter today.

item.title: Tourette syndrome activist John Davidson "upset" and "distraught" over BAFTAs N-word controversy
